name: Cinder Gulch
source:
Colorado, 1884. In the small mining town of Cinder Gulch, a farmer is found torn apart in his own barn, and the tracks leading away from the body do not look human.

The town’s sheriff has three days to find the one responsible before the full moon rises again. Every townsperson has something to hide, from the doctor and the saloon owner to the preacher and the old hunter passing through.

The player investigates locations, gathers clues and questions witnesses before accusing a suspect. The outcome depends on whom the sheriff accuses and what they have uncovered; a wrong accusation can cost another person their life.

[From the developer]

Links: https://penwof.itch.io/cinder-gulch
